population.inclusion_rule: Parent data/XAUUSD_M15.csv loaded by explicit path outside admit_csv_path and CandleLoader. n=2116. first=2026-07-07 01:00:00. last=2026-08-06 23:45:00. sha256=478b075150935c950ccc749925709db783e337c55c886d6dda1e3ee8b9692c5b. Project H1 and H4 with research.resample.resample (ParentCandleBuilder calendar rules). Feed each projected series to BacktestRunner under the research clone. Cluster = one sweep-to-displacement episode keyed by the sweep bar; overlapping holding windows share a cluster (union-find). Power floor is n_clusters >= 30 (pre-registration §14.1), not raw trades.
population.exclusion_rule: Not the 47275-row Phase-1 artifact. Not the 2300-bar parity window. Not native H4 or D1 from 1998 (F-080 parity only). Not D1 as a ladder clock (Step 4). Path A long M15 fetch is deferred. XAUUSD component cost is not applied to any other instrument. Journal pnl_rr is not y.

features.point_in_time_rule: Bare projected OHLCV plus the engine atr_abs on the entry bar only (FM-074, price units). No future bars. No full-sample rank. The one-month file is the population for this contract (pre-registration §17) and is still only the projector corpus for the §16 parity check.

atr_abs.formula_ref: market_ontology.yaml atr_absolute SMA(atr_period) of true_range in price units

labels.y_definition: Primary arm: if abs(entry-SL) < 1.5 * atr_abs, widen SL to entry ∓ 1.5 * atr_abs and recompute TP1/TP2 from the structural trade's own distance multipliers; else keep the engine prices. y_gross = multi_tp_walk rr_gross (partial 0.5, trail 0.5, tie_break production, timeout at bar close, entry_index required). y_net = y_gross - ComponentCostModel.cost_r (nights_held 0; overnight swap is unmeasured and is not charged). Diagnostic arm keeps the engine SL and is never a verdict.
labels.sign_convention: positive R is profit in units of the walked risk distance

exits.intrabar_rule: multi_tp_walk tie_break production (SL-first). SEM-016 adverse stop fill: gap-through fills at the bar open, otherwise stop slippage 0.090. TTL marks to the bar close.

splits.embargo: none — full-sample info stage on the one-month window
splits.purge: overlapping holding windows are one cluster; no purged holdout is claimed
splits.oos_fraction_or_dates: none — cluster bootstrap inside the declared window; seed 20261005; 10000 resamples; percentile 95 percent CI; random-entry seeds 20261005+i for i=0..99

economic_metrics: E[R] net is computed only when n_clusters >= 30 and is still not a promotable claim
metrics.success_gate: CONTINUE only if n_clusters >= 30 AND the cluster-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of E[R] net minus passive drift is > 0 AND the CRT mean is above the 95th percentile of 100 random-entry seeds AND long and short each clear their own passive-drift CI. Otherwise not CONTINUE.
metrics.kill_criteria: n_clusters < 30 -> INSUFFICIENT: report raw n and cluster n, publish no E[R] and no control percentile as a gate. 0 trades -> controls not applicable, verdict INSUFFICIENT. A positive point estimate below the cluster floor is not a verdict.

pipeline_identity.config_version_source: configs/research/ladder_h1.json and configs/research/ladder_h4.json cloned from configs/production/v2_htfcrt_2026_08.json; params block unchanged so config_hash still verifies
modules_explicitly_out_of_path: EngineRunner fusion gate (engine_gate_enabled false on the clone)

prohibited_substitutions.forbidden: Counting STATE_TRANSITION or TRADE_OPENED rows as the power-floor n, or swapping in the Phase-1 M15 artifact or the 28-year native H4 file
Using close-relative FM-041 atr as the 1.5 ATR stop denominator
Centered swings or any bar after the entry in the stop or the label
Reading opportunities.outcome, opportunities.rr_achieved, or journal pnl_rr as y
Replacing component_measured.v1 with flat 12bps, or applying the XAUUSD components to another instrument
Using single-target forward_walk or the engine ledger exit in place of multi_tp_walk
Treating overlapping holds as independent trades for the CI
Publishing a positive E[R] point estimate as a verdict when n_clusters < 30
Treating a funnel count or a p-value as an economic claim
Claiming the 4-engine fusion gate was on, or loading the parent through admit_csv_path
Counting an unwired sidecar (TradeNet, BitNet, rr_fusion) as part of this measurement

open_risks_non_blocking: One-month depth is below the cluster floor by construction; the run is a funnel check.
Overnight swap is unmeasured; nights_held is 0 so no carry is charged and no carry is credited.
